answer:
The philosopher who formulated the hard problem of consciousness is **David Chalmers**. He was born on **April 20, 1966**, in Sydney, Australia.

Chalmers, currently a University Professor of Philosophy at New York University, coined the term "the hard problem" around 1994-1995 when he first introduced this concept in his work on consciousness.
